```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __rspack_require, __rspack_has_own_property, __rspack_module_factories, __rspack_define_property_getters, __rspack_compat_get_default_export } from "./runtime.mjs";
import * as __rspack_external_fs from "fs";
export * from "fs";
export * from "path";
__rspack_module_factories.add({
"./dynamic-exports.js"
/*!****************************!*\
  !*** ./dynamic-exports.js ***!
  \****************************/
(__unused_rspack_module, exports) {
const def = (o) => {
  o.readFile = () => 42
}

def(exports)


},
"./runtime-decide.js"
/*!***************************!*\
  !*** ./runtime-decide.js ***!
  \***************************/
(__unused_rspack_module, __rspack_exports, __rspack_require) {
/* import */ var _dynamic_exports__rspack_import_0 = __rspack_require(/*! ./dynamic-exports */ "./dynamic-exports.js");
/* import */ var _dynamic_exports__rspack_import_0_default = /*#__PURE__*/__rspack_compat_get_default_export(_dynamic_exports__rspack_import_0);
if(__rspack_has_own_property(_dynamic_exports__rspack_import_0, "readFile")) __rspack_define_property_getters(__rspack_exports, { readFile: function() { return _dynamic_exports__rspack_import_0.readFile; } });
/* import */ var fs__rspack_import_1 = __rspack_require(/*! fs */ "fs");
if(__rspack_has_own_property(fs__rspack_import_1, "readFile")) __rspack_define_property_getters(__rspack_exports, { readFile: function() { return fs__rspack_import_1.readFile; } });


// side effects
console.log.bind()


},
"fs"
/*!*********************!*\
  !*** external "fs" ***!
  \*********************/
(module) {

module.exports = __rspack_external_fs;


},
});
// ./index.js
const runtime_decide = __rspack_require("./runtime-decide.js");



;

it('should have correct exports as its exports is decided at runtime', async () => {
  const { resolve } = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ './main.mjs');
  const { resolve: nodeResolve } = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ 'path');

  expect(resolve).toBe(nodeResolve)
  expect(runtime_decide.readFile()).toBe(42)
})

export {};
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var __rspack_modules = {};
// The module cache
var __rspack_module_cache = {};
// The require function
function __rspack_require(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = __rspack_module_cache[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (__rspack_module_cache[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
__rspack_modules[moduleId](module, module.exports, __rspack_require);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
export { __rspack_require };
// expose the modules object (__rspack_modules)
var __rspack_module_factories = __rspack_modules;
export { __rspack_module_factories };

// rspack/runtime/compat_get_default_export
// getDefaultExport function for compatibility with non-ESM modules
var __rspack_compat_get_default_export = (module) => {
	var getter = module && module.__esModule ?
		() => (module['default']) :
		() => (module);
	__rspack_define_property_getters(getter, { a: getter });
	return getter;
};
;
export { __rspack_compat_get_default_export };
// rspack/runtime/define_property_getters
var __rspack_define_property_getters = (exports, getters, values) => {
	var define = (defs, kind) => {
		for(var key in defs) {
			if(__rspack_has_own_property(defs, key) && !__rspack_has_own_property(exports, key)) {
				Object.defineProperty(exports, key, { enumerable: true, [kind]: defs[key] });
			}
		}
	};
	define(getters, "get");
	define(values, "value");
};;
export { __rspack_define_property_getters };
// rspack/runtime/esm_register_module
__rspack_module_factories.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(__rspack_module_factories, modules) }
;
// rspack/runtime/has_own_property
var __rspack_has_own_property = (obj, prop) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop));
export { __rspack_has_own_property };
```
